text.p: -- Salomon Brothers said it upgraded Novellus Systems Inc to strong buy from hold.
-- said yesterday's stock price decline was overdone.
-- Novellus lost 22 points to 53 Monday after the company warned it may face potential financial damages from a patent infringement lawsuit.
-- Salomoin said it has not changed its 1997 and 1998 earnings estimates of $4.50 a share and $5.75, respectively.
-- said Novellus has a strong operating margin, strong customer relationships, geographically diverse sales, seasoned management, and a strong balance sheet.
-- Novellus was off 1-1/4 to 51-3/4 at midday.
